column1: # *** ROSARIO: A METHOD UNLOCK, AND A LIMIT - 14 September 2026 ***

*** Confirmaciones, DGS 4531018 *** - "Catedral Nuestra Senora del Rosario. Confirmation Records 1883-1904"
column2: *** YES. FULLY TRANSCRIBED. *** Image 12 returns 4,261 characters of machine transcript, entry after entry: "ANGELA de once anos hijo legitimo de Constantino Montano y Luisa Gricelli - Maria Juana Ferrari"
column3: *** THIS IS THE FILM THAT COVERS PABLO ARMANDO *** - born February 1882, confirmable from about 1888. *** It can be READ RATHER THAN ASSEMBLED, one image per request, and every entry names BOTH PARENTS. *** That is the single most efficient unread source in this archive.

column3: Tiles remain the only route. And note the range: *** 1731-1864 *** - this film cannot hold a death after 1864, so it cannot hold anyone this archive is chasing.

column1: # ================ *** AND A HARD LIMIT ON FULL-TEXT SEARCH, MEASURED *** ================
# *** UNQUOTED TERMS ARE OR'd, NOT AND'd. *** The query  Lerena Rosario difunto  returns
# *** 17,782,105 documents *** - every document containing ANY of the three words. Quoted phrases do not
# AND either, which this archive recorded days ago.
# *** SO FAMILYSEARCH FULL TEXT ACCEPTS EXACTLY ONE QUOTED PHRASE AND NOTHING ELSE. *** There is no way
# to say "Lerena AND Rosario". Narrowing must be done by choosing a RARER PHRASE, not by adding terms.
# *** AND THE PLACE FACET IS A TRAP THAT LOOKS LIKE AN ANSWER. *** Adding  f.recordPlace=Santa Fe  to a
# full-text query returns "Full-Text Filtered Search Results (0)" and "No Results Found" - while the
# filter panel says *** "No filters available" *** against every heading. The parameter is not valid for
